scientific_integrity: The structural proof covers every permitted two-factor; enumerations independently corroborate finite instances. No independence or exhaustive bibliographic certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Every 2-factor cycle has length at least nine; ordinary zero forcing, token-jumping minimum sets. Counts for single-cycle forcing polynomials and scalar minima are prior work. Equivalence in inaccessible publications remains possible.
title: Ten-cycle signatures in minimum zero-forcing exchange graphs of two-factor complements
